title: Shop file (data/shops/<id>.json, one shop per file)
description: A shop's buy-and-sell list (GDD §10, TECH_DESIGN §21): its own wares with their prices, whether it sells seeds, and whether it buys crops. Seed prices and what a crop sells for are the crop's own (data/crops), so a new crop is on the lists without touching the shop. A conversation opens the list with the `shop` effect.

name.description: The heading of its list: "Tilda's Shop".

sells.description: Its own wares, in the order they are listed. May be empty (a shop that sells only seeds).

count.description: How many one deal gives (ten arrows). All of them must fit in the pack.

price.description: What one deal costs, in coins.

sells_seeds.description: Also sells a seed of every crop at the crop's seed_price, cheapest first.

buys_crops.description: Buys what every crop gives, one at a time, at the crop's sells_for.
